text:
morgan: Heads-up 1: small docs sync. PR #4123 updates streaming examples and pagination snippets across Python/TypeScript/Go. We're consolidating resume token rename (now resume_token) and retry shape (old `max_retries` -> `retry.max_attempts` + `retry.backoff_ms`). Need a short porting note + copy/pasteable snippets. Target: merge by Thu EOD.

jess: I'll own the Python examples. Plan: canonical pattern = `async for` with an inline `retry={\"max_attempts\": 3, \"backoff_ms\": 200}` example. Also adding a pytest async smoke test for resume-roundtrip.

sri: Taking TS. Note: TS surface is camelCase now, so `retry: { maxAttempts: 3, backoffMs: 200 }`. The client yields an AsyncIterable of parts with `text` and `resume_token`. I'll show `for await (const part of stream)` + minimal error handling.

dave: I'll craft a Go snippet showing `Next()` loop, `io.EOF` handling, and saving `ResumeToken()`. Will include a tiny snippet for resuming with context timeout.

morgan: also: update any `max_retries` mentions across the docs (grep pattern added in PR notes). Add a short paragraph on idempotency: service gives at-least-once semantics on resumed ranges, so surface non-idempotent side-effects carefully and recommend `idempotency_key`.

sam: QA bot flagged a flaky example in pagination.md where `cursor` param name was outdated. I pushed a tiny fix to replace `page_cursor` -> `cursor` and rebased. Linkcheck passed in preview.

jess: python test sketch I'll add under `docs-tests/snippets_resume.py`:
```
async def test_resume_roundtrip(client, tmp_path):
    async for p in client.stream(params):
        token = p.resume_token
        break
    resumed = []
    async for p in client.stream({**params, 'resume_token': token}):
        resumed.append(p)
    assert len(resumed) > 0
```
I'll make it robust to timing variability.

sri: For TS I'll add a jest smoke: `await expect(asyncIteratorToArray(stream())).resolves.toHaveLengthGreaterThan(0)` and assert `parts[0].resume_token` truthy. Keep code snippet under 8 lines in docs.

dave: Go example will be intentionally minimal:
```
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
defer cancel()
s, err := client.Stream(ctx, params)
for {
  chunk, err := s.Next()
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
  fmt.Println(chunk.Text)
}
tok := s.ResumeToken()
// resume: client.Stream(ctx, paramsWithResume)
```
And a short note: "Resumed streams may repeat tokens; treat text as at-least-once."

morgan: reviewers: @jess @sri @dave 1: please NAK with exact snippet text if it doesn't match SDK surfaces. I'm going to include a one-paragraph "Porting notes" section in docs: what changed and copy/paste snippets.

qa-bot: linkcheck: OK after sam's fix. docs-lint: warning in examples.md about long line; will not block merge.

sam: if conflicts appear I can rebase and squash. I also updated snippet directory to `snippets/streaming/porting-py-ts-go/` per docs layout.

jess: small nit: show both `async for` and comment `# or use async with client.stream(...) as s` to hint at context manager users.

sri: agree, TS snippet stays `for await`. Also will add a single-line note about camelCase retry vs snake_case in Python.

dave: added a brief sentence about pagination: server returns `cursor` now (not `page_token`); update old examples accordingly.

morgan: great. If nobody objects I'll merge Thu morning. I'll also add changelog entry: "Docs: SDK snippet updates for streaming (resume + retry) and pagination param rename" and ping integrators. Thanks! :tada:
